passive.name: Rising Spell Force
passive.text: Ezreal gains increasing Attack Speed each time he successfully hits a spell, stacking up to 5 times.

spells.name: Mystic Shot
spells.text: Ezreal fires a damaging bolt of energy which reduces all of his cooldowns slightly if it strikes an enemy unit.

spells.name: Essence Flux
spells.text: Ezreal fires an orb that sticks to the first champion or objective hit. If Ezreal hits an enemy with the orb, it detonates and deals damage.

spells.name: Arcane Shift
spells.text: Ezreal teleports to a target nearby location and fires a homing bolt which strikes the nearest enemy unit. Prioritizes enemies stuck with Essence Flux.

spells.name: Trueshot Barrage
spells.text: Ezreal winds up before firing a powerful barrage of energy that deals massive damage to each unit it passes through (damage is reduced for minions and non-epic monsters).

axis.value: Ezreal can poke with Mystic Shot and Essence Flux from 1150 range.

bait.why: After Ezreal uses Arcane Shift, its teleport is unavailable until the cooldown ends.
After Ezreal fires Trueshot Barrage, its long cooldown leaves the barrage unavailable.

mistakes.value: Ezreal loses Mystic Shot’s cooldown reduction when he misses an enemy unit.
